## GEOGRAPHY linestrings and the functions over them
# Source: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions
# The examples of ST_ISCLOSED, ST_CLUSTERDBSCAN, ST_MAKELINE, ST_POINTN, ST_STARTPOINT and
# ST_ENDPOINT give the WKT of linestrings; the descriptions of ST_GEOMETRYTYPE, ST_DIMENSION,
# ST_NUMPOINTS, ST_ISCOLLECTION, ST_AREA, ST_PERIMETER, ST_EQUALS and the distance functions give
# the rest, and those of ST_X, ST_Y, S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT and the linestring accessors say SAFE.
# turns their errors into NULL.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 4 3, 2 6, 0 1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 1, 4 3, 2 6, 0 1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)')
=> "LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(40 1, 42 34, 44 39)'))
=> "LINESTRING(40 1, 42 34, 44 39)"

CREATE TEMP TABLE line_geo AS SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)') AS g; SELECT g FROM line_geo
=> "LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)"

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 4 3, 2 6, 0 1)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "ST_LineString"

SELECT ST_DIMENSION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "1"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "3"

SELECT ST_NPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "3"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCOLLECTION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

# Lines have no area or perimeter.
SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_LENGTH(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

# A point covers no line, and an empty geography is at no distance.
SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 6), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1000)
=> "false"

SELECT SAFE.ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_Y(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 1)
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), -1)
=> "POINT(3 3)"

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 2)
=> "POINT(2 1)"

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), -2)
=> "POINT(3 2)"

SELECT ST_STARTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'))
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_ENDPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'))
=> "POINT(3 3)"

SELECT ST_STARTPOINT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

# Each accessor fails for anything but a linestring, and ST_POINTN where there is no vertex.
SELECT SAFE.ST_STARTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_ENDPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 5)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), -5)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 0)
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 3)])
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 2 3)"

# Points snapped together make a point, and a line's vertices are its own.
SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)])
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 3)), ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 3), ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4)), ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4), ST_GEOGPOINT(4, 5))])
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 2 3, 3 4, 4 5)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL])
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>))
=> null
